conviction_note: The quarter matters little: it closes before GTA VI launches on 19 Nov, Street sits at the top of a guide this company usually clears, and the print turns on the FY27 guide ($8.0-8.2bn against a Street near $8.53bn) and on whether management gives a pre-order number, which it declined to do in August. Evidence for demand is strong but public (Sensor Tower 7.71m digital pre-orders, Sony raising its games outlook on third-party software on 5 Nov, the Piper survey) and it drove a 13% week into the print. Against that sit a sell-the-news history (5 of the last 7 prints down) and target cuts on mobile and NBA 2K. The findings net to about +0.1, so they offset. The scaled number is slightly negative (p_up 47 x abs 8.0) because a guide that is only reiterated would leave the gap to the Street after the rally. I pulled p_up toward 50 from 45 because the call-rich skew (-26.9) says the option market expects upside.
bar: Q2 FY27 net bookings: consensus about $1.66bn (Zacks, 2026-11-04, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/seeking-clues-two-ttwo-q2-131508907.html; Koyfin via Stocktwits/CoinCentral 2026-11-09, also $1.66bn), against company guidance of $1.62-1.67bn (https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/take-two-interactive-software-inc-reports-results-fiscal-first-6). Adjusted EPS consensus is $0.90 (Zacks) to $0.97 (Koyfin); the sources disagree, so I size nothing on EPS. FY27 net bookings: company guide $8.0-8.2bn, Street about $8.53bn (Barchart, 2026-11-04, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-piper-sandler-thinks-buy-145221003.html), one source only.
positioning_check: Short interest 9,627,429 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 3.80 days to cover, about 5.1% of the 186.98M shares outstanding. It was rising slowly from 8.28M on 2026-09-15 (https://equibles.com/stocks/ttwo/shortinterest). The 10-30 settlement is not yet published. This is not a crowded short. The baseline shows 25-delta skew at -26.9 vol points, so calls are much richer than puts and upside is paid. Put/call open interest is 3.66. The event-implied move is 7.51% (straddle 8.22%). The run-up is +8.89% over 5 days and +13% for the week to 6 Nov (best week in about five months, https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/ttwo-posts-its-best-week-in-5-months-as-investors-expect-bumper-forecasts-ahead-of-gta-vi-launch/cNGrTrMR9eQ), but only +0.17% over 20 days. The stock is 19% below its 52-week high. Stocktwits retail sentiment is 'bullish' and TTWO was trending there. The market is positioned for good news.

findings.finding: Sony's fiscal Q2 release on 5 Nov 2026 (the platform that carries about 74% of tracked GTA VI pre-orders) raised its full-year Game & Network Services forecast to sales of ¥4.8tn, +6%, and operating income of ¥700bn, +6%. CFO Lin Tao attributed the raise to 'higher third-party software and network services sales'. GTA VI (19 Nov) is the dominant third-party release in Sony's December quarter. This is a counterparty statement made after Take-Two last spoke on 7 Aug. It supports FY27 bookings above Take-Two's reiterated $8.0-8.2bn, where the Street is already about $8.53bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On guidance, Feb 2025 (+14.0%) was a print that firmed the outlook and launch timing. Nov 2025 (-8.1%) raised FY bookings but announced a GTA VI delay the same day, and the delay won. Aug 2026 (+6.0%) reiterated FY27 and the 19 Nov date.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: it fell inside TTWO's 13% week. Sony did not name GTA VI, and sell-side estimates for TTWO (Street FY27 about $8.53bn) predate it or were cut that week (BTIG, Wedbush, Roth). If it were fully priced, FY27 estimates would have been revised up after 5 Nov, and the coverage I found shows only cuts.
findings.independence: Sensor Tower's pre-order tracker is a separate source pointing the same way (https://www.ggrecon.com/articles/gta-6-pre-orders-sensor-tower/). Sony's line is an inference to TTWO (macro-to-company), not a TTWO number.

findings.finding: Sensor Tower estimates 7.71m digital console pre-orders for GTA VI by 3 Nov (PS5 5.74m, Xbox 1.97m), worth about $751m, with 89% on the $99.99 Ultimate Edition. Weekly additions are accelerating: 790k in the latest week against 470k the week before, and 6.45m on 20 Oct. Cyberpunk 2077's record is about 8m including PC. Take-Two has given no official pre-order number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 2.8% on the day pre-orders opened on 25 Jun 2026, after a 13% run-up the week before. Pre-order news has been sold after run-ups.
findings.why_not_priced: It is widely syndicated, so it is mostly priced. The residual is that the 89% Ultimate mix and the accelerating weekly pace imply launch revenue per unit near $95. That supports H2 bookings above the guide's implied roughly $5bn, while the company's guide still sits about $0.3-0.5bn below the Street. If it were priced, the Street would sit even further above the guide or the guide would already have been raised.
findings.independence: Sony's 5 Nov raise on third-party software (separate document). Piper Sandler's survey (separate). All are third-party estimates, none is a company number.

findings.finding: Piper Sandler's survey of about 9,000 US teens (reported 2-4 Nov) found about 70% of current-gen console owners intend to buy GTA VI, 55% at launch, and about 40% expect to spend in-game. Piper models about 45m+ launch units and keeps a $290 target and Overweight rating. The stock rose on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: As above: pre-launch demand evidence has been bought on the way in and sold on the event (25 Jun 2026, -2.8%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: it is cited as a driver of the 13% week. The only residual is that it supports a guide raise the company has not yet made.
findings.independence: Sensor Tower (https://www.ggrecon.com/articles/gta-6-pre-orders-sensor-tower/) points the same way. Purchase intent is a proxy, not sales.

findings.finding: Positioning and expectation gap. TTWO rose 13% in the week to 6 Nov on 'investors expect bumper forecasts' and hopes for pre-order numbers. The Street's FY27 net bookings (about $8.53bn) already sit above the company's reiterated $8.0-8.2bn. Zelnick said in August that the company would not disclose pre-order figures to avoid misinterpretation by investors. If the call only reiterates the guide and declines to give a number, the gap and the rally both work against the stock, and this name has fallen after 5 of its last 7 prints.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From the baseline: -4.4% (May 2026), -5.4% (Feb 2026), -8.1% (Nov 2025), -4.0% (Aug 2025), -2.4% (May 2025). Only Feb 2025 (+14.0%) and Aug 2026 (+6.0%) rose. Median absolute move 5.38%.
findings.why_not_priced: The option market leans the other way: 25-delta skew is -26.9, so calls are rich. Against that, the call premium is the same expectation the stock rallied on, while the company's own stated policy (no pre-order number) and its unchanged guide below the Street mean the most likely release does not deliver the forecast the buyers paid for. If the market had priced a reiterate, the skew would not be this call-heavy.
findings.independence: Zelnick's disclosure stance: https://en.gamegpu.com/news/igry/predzakazy-grand-theft-auto-vi-prevzoshli-vnutrennie-ozhidaniya-izdatelya (2026-08-08). Street above guide: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-piper-sandler-thinks-buy-145221003.html (2026-11-04). Reaction history: sealed baseline.

findings.finding: BTIG (Clark Lampen) cut its TTWO target from $313 to $262 on Wed 4 Nov, keeping Buy, and cited weaker mobile game data and weaker NBA 2K reviews and user data. NBA 2K27 sits at 3.2/10 Metacritic user score and 51% on Steam. Mobile (about $3.3bn of FY26's $6.7bn, -7% in Q1) was already guided down for Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Reported-quarter lines rarely decide this name. Q1 FY27 bookings 'slightly above guide' still produced +6.0% because the GTA date held. Q2 FY26 bookings beat by 1.4% (BMO) and the stock fell 8% on the GTA delay.
findings.why_not_priced: The note is in the wire, and the stock rose 2.1% the day it came out, so it is barely weighed. The residual risk is that mobile, now about 40%+ of bookings, comes in at the low end of a guide the Street sits at the top of ($1.66bn against $1.62-1.67bn). It is offset by NBA 2K27 sell-through (next finding) and lands mostly inside what was guided.
findings.independence: User-score data: https://britbrief.co.uk/business/markets/nba-2k27-tops-us-sales-despite-32-user-score.html (2026-10-22). The same article says sales are strong, which cuts against the NBA 2K half, so this is sized net and small.

findings.finding: Circana US data has NBA 2K27 as the best-selling game of 2026 year to date (to 3 Oct) and #2 in September behind Marvel's Wolverine, in a September where US content spending fell 2% y/y. Alinea estimates $309m in premium revenue by 7 Oct. Take-Two's FY27 plan assumes NBA 2K up high single digits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: As above: reported-quarter beats have not decided this stock's reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public industry data, so it is mostly priced. It sits inside a guide the company built on NBA 2K growth. There is no y/y comparison against NBA 2K26, so it is a weak proxy.
findings.independence: Alinea estimate: https://otakukart.com/nba-2k27-has-generated-309-million-in-revenue/ (2026-10-07). This contradicts the NBA 2K half of the BTIG finding.

findings.finding: Two more target cuts into the print. Wedbush cut to $280 from $300 on 2 Nov on a revised earnings forecast, and Roth cut to $272 from $300 on 6 Nov. Separately, BofA cut to $330 from $368 on 27 Oct. Analysts have been trimming estimates as the launch nears, consistent with GTA VI marketing and amortisation costs weighing on the FY27 GAAP EPS guide of $0.55-0.75.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 2026 (-4.4%): a $300m opex increase was among the concerns raised on the first FY27 guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The cuts are public. The residual is that a cost or EPS-guide trim alongside a reiterated bookings guide would read badly after a 13% rally, and the cuts show estimates moving down, not up, into the print.
findings.independence: BofA date: https://coincentral.com/take-two-interactive-ttwo-stock-climbs-13-ahead-of-earnings-and-gta-vi-launch/ (2026-11-09). That article shares its sell-side sources with the newscase piece.

outside_window.finding: The GTA VI review embargo is reported (NateTheHate, Insider Gaming; not confirmed by Rockstar) for 18 Nov 2026, the day before launch. Review quality is the next big catalyst, and it falls after the exit window.
The GTA VI launch on 19 Nov 2026 and the first sell-through or bookings disclosures fall after the window.

baseline_tension: The demand evidence agrees with the call-rich skew (-26.9) and the 13% one-week run-up and is largely priced. The one negative (sell-the-news against a Street already above the guide) cuts against the skew. Its stated reason is the company's own disclosure policy and its reaction history, so p_up sits only slightly below 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (sign against a strong skew): positioning finding shrunk from -1.5 to -1.0. The reason the market may be wrong is stated (company non-disclosure policy, guide below the Street), but the -26.9 call skew is large. p_up moved from 45 to 47.
Lesson 9 / 6 (segment net of the rest, inside the guided range): BTIG mobile/NBA finding shrunk from -0.5 to -0.3 because mobile was already guided down and the Circana data offsets the NBA 2K half.
Lesson 1 left the positive demand findings at their draft sizes; they were already sized small for being public and for the pattern of being sold after a run-up.
